label: Set up
hint: Clear the table and lay out the cards, dice and markers again.
confirm: This clears the table and sets it up again. Continue?

label: Deal 3 core cards
hint: Three cards from the core deck into each person's hand.
announce: {name} dealt three core cards to each person.

label: Deal 3 sidebar cards
hint: Three cards from the sidebar into each person's hand.
announce: {name} dealt three sidebar cards to each person.

label: Reset
hint: Remove every card, every added deck and all ink.
confirm: This removes every piece and all ink from the table. Continue?

label: Shuffle decks
hint: Shuffle the core deck and the sidebar.
announce: {name} shuffled the core deck and the sidebar.

label: Collect cards
hint: Every card back into the pile it came from, face down, shuffled.
announce: {name} collected every card back into its pile.
